messages:
Priya Nair: Quick follow-up from the DB failover postmortem — need owners for remediation items, create JIRA for each, define RACI, and a handoff into sprint. Who picks what?
Miguel Santos: I can own the runbook rewrite + DR test plan. Will open a JIRA (INF-5229) and aim for EOW (2w).
Samir Patel: I'll take autoscaler tuning + dashboards. Creating OPS-3135 now and will #incarnate monitoring panels.
Ingrid Holm: I'll handle alert thresholds and dedupe rules (SRE). Need write access to cluster-alerts board — @Lina can you grant?
Lina (ProductOps): Granted write to cluster-alerts for @Ingrid. Also ProductOps should be consulted on user-facing messages (we're C).
Priya Nair: Proposed RACI: Miguel R/A runbook, Samir R/A autoscaler, Ingrid R/A alerts, Lina C, Priya I final sign-off. OK?
Miguel Santos: OK.
Samir Patel: Fine with me.
Ingrid Holm: Agreed.
Priya Nair: Timelines: Miguel & Samir 2 weeks, Ingrid 1 week, Lina to draft comms once notified. Escalate blockers here.
Miguel Santos: INF-5229 opened -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-5229 (runbook + playbook).
Samir Patel: OPS-3135 created -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OPS-3135 (autoscaler + dashboards).
Ingrid Holm: ALERT-204 created -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ALERT-204 (thresholds + dedupe).
Priya Nair: @DevOps Bot can you schedule a checkpoint reminder for 2026-04-05 10:00AM PT to review progress and run DR test?
DevOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: "PM remediation checkpoint: INF-5229, OPS-3135, ALERT-204" on 2026-04-05 10:00AM PT.
Samir Patel: Noted a recurring pattern: scaling lag during medium traffic ramps. Logged as cause in OPS-3135. Suggest adding a synthetic load test in staging to detect regressions.
Priya Nair: Add subtask for synthetic load test under OPS-3135 and assign to Samir.
Samir Patel: Done: OPS-3135-1 (staging synthetic test).
Ingrid Holm: Proposing monthly DR drills to uncover other recurring issues — will set up recurring calendar event if everyone agrees.
Miguel Santos: +1 monthly drills.
Lina (ProductOps): I'll create recurring invite including SRE/Infra/Prod.
Priya Nair: Final: update the remediation tracker after creating tickets. I'll do a final review next Friday.
Miguel Santos: I'll update tracker when INF-5229 has initial draft.
Samir Patel: I'll update when OPS-3135 dashboard PR merges.
Ingrid Holm: I'll post ALERT-204 threshold snippets once live.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. Keep updates in the JIRAs and the tracker. :thumbsup:
